annotations.title: Turn a vague design phrase into a concrete design brief

description: Use when a user (often not a designer) gives vague design feedback or a request such as "make it pop", "more premium", "cleaner", "less boring", "feels off" and you need specific, actionable design changes rather than guesses. Matches the phrase to design terms and returns what it usually means, concrete moves (spacing, contrast, type, color, hierarchy) and a ready-to-use design brief, with an option to avoid generic AI-looking choices. Example: {"phrase": "make it pop"}.

avoid_ai_look.description: Add rules that steer away from the generic AI-made look. Default true.

phrase.description: The vague request in plain words, e.g. "it feels cheap and too busy".

name: lingo_translate_design_request
